decisions.reason: The church-motif music box builds on the firm's established Erzgebirge-style offer and seasonal demand, so its results are unlikely to fall below aspiration in its first full year, and the firm's slack lets it carry the product while results remain uncertain.

A wooden nativity stable is a core, steady-selling item for specialist retailers and collectors, so there is no performance shortfall to trigger problemistic search, and keeping it fits the firm's established routines.

The modern incense smoker supports the firm's stated move toward contemporary design within its established category, so management would likely give it at least another season before judging it against aspirations.
